id: title:Gilbert09:stop reporting transient rpc timeouts during row count estimation

review.posthog_relevance: Redshift warehouse ingestion: Redshift may return transient RPC errors between leader and compute nodes. This could cause row-count estimation to fail. The change treats this specific transient error as a non-actionable, best-effort failure, returning 0 and not reporting it to error tracking.
review.reason: Adds a check for the string 'Remote request timeout' in the exception message and returns 0 without reporting the error, while also adding a corresponding test.
